name: local-llm
description: Delegate routine coding work to a local OpenAI-compatible model and see its live stats (time, tokens, speed, context) above the prompt

base_url.title: Server URL
base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, such as http://localhost:1234/v1. Leave empty to find LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM or Jan on their usual ports.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id as the server lists it. Leave empty to use the first chat model the server lists.

context_length.title: Context length
context_length.description: Tokens of context the model is loaded with, for the % shown. 0 asks the server (LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM and Ollama report it).

show_stats.title: Live stats above the prompt
show_stats.description: Show the model's progress, tokens, speed and context use above the prompt while it works.
